segments.name: Mining
segments.description: Exploration, evaluation, development, mining and milling of uranium, including toll milling services.
segments.evidence: The Mining segment includes activities related to exploration, evaluation and development, mining, milling (including toll milling) and the sale of mineral concentrates.

segments.name: Corporate and Other
segments.description: General corporate expenses not allocated to operating segments.
segments.evidence: The Corporate and Other segment includes general corporate expenses not allocated to the other segments.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay for toll milling services and mineral concentrates from mining operations.

changes.text: In 2025, the Company discontinued its environmental services business segment that previously provided mine decommissioning and other services to third parties.
changes.evidence: The Company also previously had a third primary segment of operations, which segment included the results of the Company's environmental services business which provided mine decommissioning and other services to third parties.
